mapper.insert: INSERT INTO requirement (publisher_id, title, detail, category_id, budget_min, budget_max, audit_status, requirement_status, visibility_status) VALUES (#{publisherId}, #{title}, #{detail}, #{categoryId}, #{budgetMin}, #{budgetMax}, #{auditStatus}, #{requirementStatus}, #{visibilityStatus})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM requirement WHERE publisher_id = #{publisherId}
mapper.update: UPDATE requirement SET audit_status = #{auditStatus}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE requirement SET visibility_status = #{visibilityStatus}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
